config.database.server.name: employee_db
config._comment_plugin: pgoutput is PostgreSQL's built-in logical decoding plugin (v10+). Alternative: wal2json (older plugin for LogMiner-style output)
config.plugin.name: pgoutput
config._comment_slot: Replication slot name — PostgreSQL holds WAL data until Debezium reads it. Keep slot name unique per connector.
config.slot.name: debezium_employee_slot
config._comment_publication: PostgreSQL publication — defines which tables to stream. 'ALL_TABLES' captures every table.
config.publication.name: debezium_employee_pub
config._comment_tables: Comma-separated list of tables to capture. Only these tables generate CDC events.
config._comment_topic: Each table's CDC events go to: {server.name}.{schema}.{table}
config._comment_snapshot:
How to handle the initial snapshot of existing data.
  initial: snapshot all rows first, then stream new changes
  never: skip snapshot, only stream changes from now on
  schema_only: capture schema but no existing data rows
config._comment_heartbeat: Heartbeat messages keep the WAL slot alive when no DML activity. Prevents WAL bloat when Debezium is idle.
config.heartbeat.action.query: INSERT INTO public.debezium_heartbeat (ts) VALUES (NOW()) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
config._comment_outbox_router:
Debezium Outbox Event Router — transforms outbox table CDC events into business domain events.
Instead of raw INSERT events, it publishes structured domain events routed to the right Kafka topic.
config._comment_key_converter: Use string for key (employee ID), JSON for value — simpler than Avro for dev. Use Avro in production for schema evolution.
config._comment_decimal: Numeric precision: double for performance vs string for exact financial values. Use DOUBLE for metrics, STRING for salary fields.
config._comment_time: Timestamps as epoch milliseconds — easier to consume than PostgreSQL timestamp strings.
